name: trainer-desk
postCreateCommand: bash -lc 'set -e; if [ ! -f .env ]; then cp .env.example .env; fi; sed -i "s/^DB_CONNECTION=.*/DB_CONNECTION=sqlite/" .env; sed -i "s|^DB_DATABASE=.*|DB_DATABASE=database/database.sqlite|" .env; mkdir -p database; touch database/database.sqlite; mkdir -p .claude; cp tools/claude-settings.json .claude/settings.json; php -m | grep -qi pdo_sqlite || { echo "FATAL: pdo_sqlite missing"; exit 1; }; composer install --no-interaction --prefer-dist; npm install; grep -q "^APP_KEY=base64:" .env || php artisan key:generate --force; php artisan migrate --force; npm run build; bash tools/smoke-test.sh'
